questions.question: When the army of Aram surrounded the city of Samaria for a long time, what hit the city?
During the siege of Samaria, four men with leprosy decided to leave the city gate. Where did they decide to go?

answers.text: Over to the camp of the Arameans
Down to the land of Egypt

questions.question: What did the Lord cause the Aramean army camped around Samaria to hear, making them run away?

answers.text: Chariots and horses and a great army
The walls of Samaria cracking apart
Trumpets blowing from the city gate

questions.question: What happened to the king's officer who doubted Elisha's promise of cheap food during the siege of Samaria?

answers.text: The people trampled him and he died
He ate the first flour from the camp
He chased the Arameans to the Jordan
